featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience. Would not recommend.

I had taken an appointment 24 hrs in advance. This salon has a serious issue with double-booking clients and complete disregard for customer comfort and time. This has happened to me multiple times, and I ignored it earlier but this last visit was unacceptable.

I had an appointment with a specific stylist named Joti. Instead of attending to me, they put conditioner on my hair and made me lie on that extremely uncomfortable wash bed, with my neck resting on the basin (which barely works), and left me there for 20 minutes. When I asked what was happening, In front of me she was busy blow-drying someone else and said please give me sometime.

Anyone who knows salons knows a blow-dry takes at least 30 minutes. Their plan was clearly to keep me lying there with my neck strained on the basin for 30–40 minutes. I honestly don’t know how they thought this was acceptable or humane.

This isn’t a one-off. Another time, I booked an appointment with a stylist named Mohammad, only to get a call later saying he suddenly had a “private client” and wouldn’t be available—after my booking was already confirmed.

This place clearly prioritises overbooking and select clients over basic professionalism and customer care. If you value your time, comfort, and dignity, I would strongly recommend avoiding this salon. Otherwise, be prepared for sheer disappointment.
